verdict.rationale: The pack documents no explicit retention or deletion controls. The only indirect lever is avoiding stagewise's servers: BYOK for every provider means no requests go through the managed service, local models run with zero external API calls, and enterprise customers can self-host the stagewise Cloud. A community user also reports that the dataflow, meaning what is actually sent to the LLM, is undocumented. missing for 10: documented retention policy, user-facing deletion of chats/account data, retention period settings, data export/erasure controls, independent verification.
